prior_negative: K5F external current-front guard 15/16 goals versus unchanged R3 6/16; strong same-info conventional tied 15/16. This proposed experiment is NOT an intrinsic novel native memory algorithm.

upstream.old_training: exact K4Z FIT 17400..17423 only, 12000 original source actions, no prior CHECK/DEV

observation_contract: The source exposes full current original public grid to audited environment adapter solely to extract current agent pose, heading, goal, and a true 1-bit front occupancy when (and only when) a scan is purchased. Candidate R3 and conventional online planner may receive pose and goal each step, last observed front occupancy only if its exact oriented pose was previously scanned; a stale cache is not guaranteed current. Never pass global scene/image/ball positions to learning/policy. The full-grid image is retained only as SHA in evidence.
actions_and_scan: Each scan is an optional pre-action 1-bit front occupancy query, free of additional env movement but counted against the strictly matched fixed per-episode scan budget. Agent still executes one original physical left/right/forward env.step; other models see own action consequences and own scanned measurements. No blind unmetered front observations.

frozen_rules.active: Use source R3/online proposal with cached-only front bits; when proposed action is FORWARD and current oriented pose has never been scanned, or last scan age >=4 actual steps, spend one remaining scan. Then recompute proposal with fresh front data, and veto any proposed FORWARD if sampled front occupied. No use of future obstacles or source RNG. If budget exhausted, use cached source state and no hazard veto beyond existing cached front.
frozen_rules.periodic: For each policy count its own consecutive FORWARD proposals; scan on proposals #1,#4,#7,... until budget exhausted. Recompute proposed action after read and veto FORWARD if actual sampled occupied. Same 1-bit sensor content and scan cap as active, no extra observations.
frozen_rules.no_scan: Never scan current front; only pose/goal and already observed own before/action/after pose changes reach native R3, front held false.
frozen_rules.full_sensor_upper: Reveal current front occupancy every action without cap, with immediate veto; declared privileged reference for safety not a budget-matched learning competitor.

primary_science.safety_gain: For BOTH scan budgets, total 16-new-world native active goals >= native periodic goals +2 AND native active hazard terminations <= periodic hazards -2. These are prereg exploratory information-allocation criteria; if not met, signed negative.
primary_science.parity: Strong equally informed conventional active and periodic policies must be evaluated with same scan limits and real source. An equal or better conventional active scorer VETOES native-architecture-superiority regardless of native active-vs-periodic performance.
primary_science.resource: Preserve per-step physically real before-action-next public pose, scan decision+measured bit when purchased, true terminal/reward, cumulative scan counts, CPU/selection/update wall, entire process CPU/RSS/checkpoint sizes. Match number of permitted queries; report actual queries separately.
primary_science.integrity: Two fresh Python processes, exact outcome equality excluding measured times, source hashes verified before any CHECK/DEV episode. No tuning on new heldout. Do not conflate selective sensing with native discovery of causal rules or learned representations.
